eyepieces.name: Baader Classic Plossl 32mm
eyepieces.priority: Useful for finding targets and brighter extended views. About 18% wider field diameter than the inherited Super 25 mm profile, not twice as wide.

eyepieces.name: TS-Optics N-ED 12mm
eyepieces.priority: 108× on MAK 102: useful when the air will not support more. Optional comfort upgrade; the stock 10 mm already covers a nearby 130×.

eyepieces.name: Sky-Watcher SWA-58 8mm
eyepieces.priority: 162.5×: a sensible next step beyond the stock 10 mm when seeing is steady. Choose this or the N-ED 8; buying both duplicates magnification.

eyepieces.name: TS-Optics N-ED 8mm
eyepieces.priority: Same 162.5× as SWA 8, with a 60-degree field and specified 16 mm eye relief. The render cannot compare brand sharpness or comfort.

eyepieces.name: Sky-Watcher SWA-58 7mm
eyepieces.availability: On request; seller lists a wait of weeks
eyepieces.priority: 185.7× with a 0.55 mm exit pupil. More demanding of seeing, focus and mount vibration; not the first purchase.

eyepieces.name: Baader Classic Ortho 6mm
eyepieces.priority: 216.7× exceeds the nominal 2× aperture guideline of 204×. A 0.47 mm exit pupil and 5 mm eye relief are demanding; a bigger render need not contain extra visible detail.
